behaviors.assignee-options: Opening the Assignee filter shows Anyone, each person, and Unassigned with current task counts.
behaviors.search-assignees: Typing a name in Find a person narrows the dropdown options.
behaviors.filter-by-person: Selecting a person shows only their tasks, respects the selected status, and updates the task summary.
behaviors.filter-unassigned: Selecting Unassigned shows only tasks without an assignee.
behaviors.empty-assignee-state: Selecting Ana Lima shows an empty state saying nothing is assigned to her yet, with a Clear filters control.
behaviors.clear-filters: Clear filters restores All statuses and Anyone, showing all seeded tasks again.

history.notes: The tour uses the toolbar’s assignee button and status select to avoid matching task-card controls. Counts and task names come from the supplied seed data.
